attr.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team Recomp
attr.desc: Native GBA recompilation for ARM64 handhelds using SDL2.
attr.inst: Requires your own Red Rescue Team USA/Australia ROM and GBA BIOS. The build workflow verifies these privately but does not redistribute them. Copy the files listed in ASSETS_REQUIRED.txt into the port's bios/ and roms/ folders.
